# Ahsan Amin Gorsi

> Ahsan Amin Gorsi is a .NET C# web developer and BSCS student from Kotli, Azad Kashmir, Pakistan. He builds web applications with ASP.NET MVC, C# and SQL Server, and is the founder of Acadivo, an educational platform for sharing academic materials. He is open to freelance work and collaborations.

## Quick facts
- Name: Ahsan Amin Gorsi (also written Ahsan Amin)
- Role: .NET C# Web Developer, Founder of Acadivo
- Education: BSCS (2023–2027), University of Kotli, Azad Jammu & Kashmir
- Location: Khuiratta, Kotli, Azad Kashmir, Pakistan
- Core stack: C#, ASP.NET MVC, SQL Server, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bootstrap, Git
- Award: Recognition Award, Entrepreneurship Innovation Conference 2025 (EIC 25), University of Kotli
- Availability: open to freelance web development, backend development, UI/UX and graphic design, and tech consultation
- Contact: ahsanamingorsi@gmail.com, WhatsApp +92 349 5473628

## Projects
- AskPaperGen: exam paper generator that helps teachers build structured question papers with sections and images (ASP.NET MVC, C#, SQL Server). https://ahsanamingorsi.github.io/AskPaperGen/
- Acadivo: educational platform where students share and access academic materials, with profiles, file management and a points system (ASP.NET MVC, C#, SQL Server).
- Flixsan: movie information site showing trending movies dynamically from external APIs (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). https://github.com/ahsanamingorsi/FlixSan

## Experience
